key_insight: The band alignment at 2D/3D perovskite interfaces is highly sensitive to surface termination and chemical composition, which can strongly alter work function and band offsets.
engineering_relevance: Tuning 2D/3D interface chemistry offers a practical route to improve perovskite solar-cell passivation, stability, and charge extraction.
method: Hybrid functional calculations for electronic structure
Systematic comparison of work function, electron affinity, and band offsets across terminations
evidence_signal: The abstract reports preliminary calculations showing work functions and band offsets vary substantially with cleavage and chemistry, with valence band offsets around 0.2 to 0.7 eV and conduction offsets near 0.25 eV.
watch_item: Results are preliminary and based on idealized simulated interfaces, so real-device disorder, defects, and processing effects may shift the observed alignments.
paper_title: Material chemical composition impacts on the band alignments: preliminary results on the 3D/2D perovskite interfaces
